'''Starwind Chandlery''' was a general store and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitter that was located in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]], in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]. It was managed by an old [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Labio]], and was clerked by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mioe]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wurrooba]]. Starwind Chandlery supplied the majority of [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] equipment, ranging from [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuits]] to a small variety of weapons such as [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. The store's main source of business was supplying starships with consumables such as [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] and [[Water/Legends|water]]. A ship the size of an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] could take the entire stock of the store's ship consumables and it would last the crew of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] a couple of [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. Starwind Chandlery could, however, arrange larger orders of consumables at a [[Standard month/Legends|month's]] notice.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Starwind Chandlery first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate ''[[Far Orbit]]''. The scenario provided it as an example of the stores in the market that the crew of the ''Far Orbit'' could visit.
